decidedBy: Essenthos, 2026-10-08, on Strong's entries that number several men under a name the corpus held one record for, proposed by gpt-6.1-sol (Codex, reasoning high) on 2026-10-07 and each occurrence read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5, under the project owner's decision of 2026-09-16 that a namesake the text does not identify is a person of his own and that where the text leaves an identification open the record says so
policy: A record is one man, and a word names the one its verse names. Where one record held a second man Strong numbers under the name, his occurrences go to a record of his own; where his record was held already, his words are given to him.
source: Essenthos, on Strong's entries numbering several men under one held name, each occurrence read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-08

create.name: Galal
create.distinguisher: a Levite who dwelt in Jerusalem after the return, named with Bakbakkar, Heresh and Mattaniah (1CH 9:15)
create.notes: Whether he is the man of that name in 1CH 9:16 the text does not say.

rulings.why: 'And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah' among the Levites who dwelt in Jerusalem; the Galal of the next verse is the son of Jeduthun and the forefather of Obadiah, and the text does not make the two one.

create.name: Hachmoni
create.distinguisher: whose son Jashobeam was the chief of David's captains (1CH 11:11)
create.notes: Whether he is the man of that name in 1CH 27:32 the text does not say.

rulings.why: 'Jashobeam, the son of Hachmoni, the chief of the captains' (בֶּן־חַכְמוֹנִי); the Hachmoni whose son Jehiel was with the king's sons (1CH 27:32) is not said to be the same man.

create.name: Jabin
create.distinguisher: king of Canaan who reigned in Hazor in the days of Deborah and Barak, whose captain was Sisera (JDG 4:2)
create.notes: Not the king of JOS 11:1, who was slain when his city was taken (JOS 11:10).

rulings.why: 'And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor': the oppressor of Judges 4 and Psalm 83:9, long after the Jabin Joshua slew and whose city he burnt (JOS 11:10-11).

create.name: Chelub
create.distinguisher: father of Ezri, who was over the tillage of the ground for King David (1CH 27:26)
create.notes: Whether he is the man of that name in 1CH 4:11 the text does not say.

rulings.why: 'And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub': an officer's father under David; the Chelub of 1 Chronicles 4:11, Shuah's brother, is not said to be him.

create.name: Adin
create.distinguisher: one of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant in the days of Nehemiah (NEH 10:16)
create.notes: Whether he is the forefather of the house of that name whose children came up from Babylon (EZR 2:15, NEH 7:20) the text does not say.

rulings.why: 'Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin' among the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant (NEH 10:14-16), a man living in Nehemiah's day; the Adin whose children came up with Zerubbabel (EZR 2:15) is a forefather.

create.name: Azgad
create.distinguisher: one of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant in the days of Nehemiah (NEH 10:15)
create.notes: Whether he is the forefather of the house of that name whose children came up from Babylon (EZR 2:12, NEH 7:17) the text does not say.

rulings.why: 'Bunni, Azgad, Bebai' among the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant (NEH 10:14-15), a man living in Nehemiah's day; the Azgad whose children came up with Zerubbabel (EZR 2:12) is a forefather.

create.name: Pahath-moab
create.distinguisher: one of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant in the days of Nehemiah (NEH 10:14)
create.notes: Whether he is the forefather of the house of that name whose children came up from Babylon (EZR 2:6, NEH 7:11) the text does not say.

rulings.why: 'Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam' at the head of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant (NEH 10:14), a man living in Nehemiah's day; the Pahath-moab whose children came up with Zerubbabel (EZR 2:6) is a forefather.

create.name: Parosh
create.distinguisher: first of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant in the days of Nehemiah (NEH 10:14)
create.notes: Whether he is the forefather of the house of that name whose children came up from Babylon (EZR 2:3, NEH 7:8) the text does not say.

rulings.why: 'The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahath-moab' who sealed the covenant (NEH 10:14), a man living in Nehemiah's day; the Parosh whose children came up with Zerubbabel (EZR 2:3) is a forefather.

create.name: Ziha
create.distinguisher: who with Gispa was over the Nethinims dwelling in Ophel (NEH 11:21)
create.notes: Whether he is the forefather of the house of that name whose children came up from Babylon (EZR 2:43, NEH 7:46) the text does not say.

rulings.why: 'But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims': a man set over them in Nehemiah's day; the children of Ziha of Ezra 2:43 are a house of the Nethinims.

create.name: Ittai
create.distinguisher: son of Ribai, of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, one of David's thirty mighty men (2SA 23:29, 1CH 11:31)
create.notes: Another man than the one of that name from Gath (2SA 15:19-22).

rulings.why: 'Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin' among the thirty (2SA 23:29; Ithai, 1CH 11:31): a Benjamite, where the Ittai of 2 Samuel 15 is a Gittite, a stranger and an exile.
'Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite' among the thirty: the father of Heleb, not Ish-bosheth's captain.
'Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite' (1CH 11:30), the father of Heleb of 2 Samuel 23:29.
'Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah': the Korahite, not Hezekiah's porter.
'Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph': the Korahite of 9:19, not Hezekiah's porter.
'And of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites' among the sons of Gilead: Gilead's son, not Shemida's.
'Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army': the Jabin of Judges 4:2.
'For there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber': the Jabin of Judges 4:2.
'So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan': the Jabin of Judges 4:2.
'And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin': the Jabin of Judges 4:2.
'until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan': the Jabin of Judges 4:2.
'Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison' (Psalm 83:9): the Jabin of Judges 4, whose captain was Sisera.
'Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin': Ittai son of Ribai of 2 Samuel 23:29.
